answer: Reaching the pulse of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The cedar holds work receipts rather than names, so the timber of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
